title: Shift compatibility of strict-system realization maps
statement: Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $t$, and $A_n=R/t^n$. Let $W$ be a finite-type $k$-scheme with its small pro-etale site, put $\widehat R_W=\lim_n(A_n)_W$, and let $\mathscr S_W$ be the abelian category of strict semilinear systems of $(A_n)_W$-module sheaves with derived reduction $\mathcal R_W$ and total-limit functor $\mathcal L_W=R\lim\operatorname{Res}$. Restrict to normalized systems with compatible etale-origin witnesses, bounded constructible cohomology and finite Tor amplitude in common finite intervals. For a finite well-typed expression $V$ in the system pullback, system direct image, open extension and derived tensor, with derived-complete constructible integral inputs $K_1,\ldots,K_s$ and all intermediate objects in those bounds, let $c_V:\mathcal L_WV(\mathcal R K_1,\ldots,\mathcal R K_s)\xrightarrow{\sim}V_{\mathrm{int}}(K_1,\ldots,K_s)$ be the canonical realization isomorphism of [lem-sf-integral-compactification-system-realization]. Treat input slots as individual leaf occurrences in the expression tree; a repeated object has independent occurrence slots. For a designated input slot $i$ and $r\in\mathbf Z$, write $V^{(i,r)}$ for the same expression with only $K_i$ replaced by $K_i[r]$; for a tensor node, the comparison in the shifted slot is the signed tensor comparison (in particular this specifies the second-slot Koszul sign). For each compactification $f=pj$, choose the strict tower model $U_W S_pJ_j\mathcal R K$ (termwise restriction of scalars of a simultaneous system resolution) realizing the inverse system in [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], and use its Roos total-cone representative, and define the completed integral shift on $Rf_!$ by the termwise cochain shift and the induced shifted-cone comparison of that representative. Equip the system expression and its integral counterpart with these slotwise canonical shift comparisons. Then for every $i,r$, the square expressing that $c_{V^{(i,r)}}$ after the system shift equals the integral shift after $c_V$ commutes, naturally in all inputs. The same holds after whiskering by any such expression and for every canonical system map (units, counits, pullback/tensor maps, direct-image compositors, proper/open interchange and projection maps) together with its corresponding integral map.

For any synchronized canonical pair, preserve its labelled occurrence set by induction on its isomorphism/basic/context constructors (tensor associativity uses the sum associativity equivalence). This propagates injectivity from the independent source to every intermediate composition. The identical constructor induction therefore gives TreeSynchronizedPair for the full selected collection.
